operation.description: Schedule operation to perform. Use create for new one-shot or recurring schedules; use list/describe to inspect; use update/delete/pause/resume/trigger to manage existing schedules.

schedule_id.description: Existing schedule ID for describe/update/delete/pause/resume/trigger. For create, pass an empty string to let OpenCTO generate a project-scoped ID, or a short stable slug like "daily-hello".

name.description: Short human-readable schedule name. Use an empty string for operations that do not need a name.

task.description: The exact instruction OpenCTO should execute when the schedule fires. Required for create and update. Do not include the scheduling phrase here; include only the future task, such as "deploy this app" or "send me hello in Discord".

one_shot_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp for one-shot schedules, e.g. "2026-05-07T09:00:00+04:00". Use an empty string for recurring schedules and non-create/update operations.

cron.description: Temporal cron expression for recurring schedules, e.g. "0 9 * * *" or "@every 24h". Interpret natural language before calling this tool. Do not include TZ/CRON_TZ prefixes; OpenCTO uses the host IANA timezone. Use an empty string for one-shot schedules and non-create/update operations.

paused.description: For create/update, whether the schedule should start paused. Use false unless the user asks to create it paused.

note.description: Optional short note explaining the schedule or management action. Use an empty string when unnecessary.

limit.description: Maximum schedules to list. Use 0 for the default. Ignored for operations other than list.
